summary.text: Matthew Buehler is the Republican candidate for the Nevada State Senate, District 13, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces incumbent Democrat Skip Daly.
A U.S. Air Force veteran, he has worked as an ROTC commander and as an educator.

paragraphs.text: Matthew Buehler served in the U.S. Air Force.

He earned a bachelor's degree in biomedical engineering from Arizona State University in 1992, a master's degree in information systems from the University of Nevada, Las Vegas in 2004, and a master's degree in biology/developmental neuroscience from the University of Nevada, Reno in 2009.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as including work as an ROTC commander and as an educator.
Buehler was the Republican nominee for Nevada State Senate District 13 in 2022, losing to Skip Daly, 61.6% to 38.4%.
The Republican primary for the seat in 2026 was canceled, and he advanced to the general election.
